summary: Configured node1 so new interactive login sessions default to umask 027. Verified file mode 0640 and directory mode 0750, including after a successful node restart.
actions_performed: Created /etc/profile.d/secure-umask.sh with root:root ownership and mode 0644.
Verified a fresh interactive login reports umask 0027.
Restarted node1 safely and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified system health, SSH availability, configuration persistence, and fresh-login behavior after restart.

evidence.requirement: New interactive login sessions use default umask 027
evidence.summary: Shows the installed configuration, effective umask 0027, resulting file mode 0640 and directory mode 0750, and identical behavior after restart.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart and recovery evidence for node1
evidence.summary: Captures the healthy baseline and original boot ID, safe restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered system, SSH endpoint, configuration, and login-session behavior.
